note: Business values the platform reads from the EXISTING b2b_settings table. None of them is inserted by the migrations. While a key is absent the platform uses the fail-safe behaviour listed here, never the proposal. Setting a key requires core.settings.edit and an approval by a different person; who approved it and when is kept in the audit log.

settings.while_unset: No automatic accept/reject on shelf life. Each GRN line shows life left; the receiver must tick 'shelf life reviewed' per line before posting.
FEFO allocation exactly as today (existing behaviour); near-expiry stock is reported, not blocked.
FEFO allocation exactly as today (existing behaviour); near-expiry stock is reported, not blocked.
Near-expiry report lists lots by days to expiry only; no percentage flag.
Invoices print products.hsn_code exactly as today. Imports report HSN conflicts but never overwrite HSN.
No digit-count rule enforced beyond the existing format check.
Existing B2B keeps using products.gst_rate unchanged. A NEW price list cannot be published for a product with no approved b2b_tax_rates row (fail closed for the new flow only).
Only the tiers the existing B2B already sells (retailer, distributor). Super-stockist accounts cannot be approved or priced.
Existing pricing engine precedence (rules, product prices, default margins) — unchanged.
The brand's scheme % is recorded as purchase-side information only; no selling discount is created from it.
Every PO needs approval by a Super Admin (one step, not the requester).
One approval by a Super Admin other than the submitter.
Every supplier payment needs Super Admin approval.
Zero tolerance: any difference between PO, GRN and bill blocks payment until resolved.
Any received quantity different from the dispatch notice needs warehouse-manager approval.
Salesman OTP ordering is switched off (the feature cannot run without approved values).
The read-only online-shop feed does not run; online sales are not posted to the ledger.
Nothing is ever purged.
The owner's initial limits apply: at most 500 recipients per send, 20 sends per administrator per hour, promotional sends above 100 recipients need a second person's approval.

settings.decision: N3 (provider throughput; depends on the SMTP / Meta tier / MSG91 plan chosen)
settings.while_unset: The worker hands at most 30 emails, 60 WhatsApp messages and 60 SMS per minute to the providers; the rest wait in the queue (no attempt is used up). Set to the limits of the plans actually bought.
off: the online shop behaves exactly as today; the business ledger is not involved in shop checkouts.

settings.type: id (a warehouse of type online_shop that ships shop orders)
settings.while_unset: The shop stock layer cannot run in shadow or enforce mode; it stays off.
A stock hold made at Pay lasts 30 minutes, then is released if no paid order used it.
A paid shop checkout that cannot get stock is recorded as an exception and refunded only when staff press Refund (shop_stock.resolve).
Shop customers are linked into the unified customer list only when staff run the import from the Customers screen.

settings.type: id (the vendor record that stands for our own plant; batches made in-house carry it as manufacturer)
settings.while_unset: In-house manufacturing orders can be planned and materials issued, but their output cannot be recorded, because the batch would have no manufacturer of record.
Dispatch warns when a shipment worth more than 50,000 rupees has no e-way bill number, but does not stop it.
No limit: staff decide when to stop trying and return the goods to the warehouse.
Late shipments and late manufacturer deliveries are marked on the screens; no alert is sent.
